stories.headline: Bumble Tried to Change Dating, but the Dating Market Forced It to Change Instead
stories.dek: The app now allows men to make the first move, suggesting its women-first positioning was limiting growth. It joins other dating apps now throwing everything at the wall in a bid to stay relevant.
